note: Task D part definitions (diagnostic closures, never written to any XML). round_added = the discovery round whose output introduced the part; discovery round r closes every part with round_added < r. Closures: fwd / rev / whole (common.close). Round 0 = parts_pool.json (config A). Grouping into tier-1 groups is added before the 2^k runs.

parts.mechanism: cytosolic NAD/NADP pair: NAD-MTHFD R549 (oxidative, NADH) with NADP-MTHFD R550 reverse (reductive, NADPH) = NADPH -> NADH
parts.source: pair scan R549/R550; escape directions R549 fwd, R550 rev (parts_pool.json)

parts.mechanism: cytosolic NAD/NADP pair written in opposite directions: NAD-GDH R329 (glutamate -> 2-OG, NADH) with NADP-GDH R330 (2-OG -> glutamate, NADPH) = NADPH -> NADH
parts.source: pair scan R329/R330; escape direction R329 fwd; R330 is required by WT in the same direction (capacity step, not closed)

parts.mechanism: cytosolic acetaldehyde dehydrogenase cofactor choice: NAD-ALD R1378 (NADH) instead of NADP-ALD R134 (NADPH)
parts.source: pair scan R1378/R134; escape direction R1378 fwd; R134 is required by WT (capacity step)

parts.mechanism: matrix acetaldehyde dehydrogenase cofactor choice: NADP-ALD R136 (matrix NADPH) instead of NAD-ALD R135/R2070 (matrix NADH)
parts.source: pair scans R135/R136 and R2070/R136; escape direction R136 fwd

parts.mechanism: matrix NADP-IDH R1385 in the reductive-carboxylation direction (2-OG + CO2 + NADPH -> isocitrate); pair R487/R1385
parts.source: pair scan R487/R1385; escape direction R1385 rev (WT requires forward)

parts.mechanism: succinyl-CoA:acetate CoA-transferase (matrix acetate -> acetyl-CoA)
parts.source: handoff (user, Task C Amendment 2): own part, closed whole

parts.mechanism: matrix HMG-CoA synthase R412 + HMG-CoA transport R1172 (matrix acetyl-unit export)
parts.source: handoff (user, Task C Amendment 2): one part, closed whole

parts.mechanism: cytosol <-> lipid-particle NADPH/NADP+ exchange (no GPR)
parts.source: transport scan; escape directions R1628 fwd, R1629 rev (0.0256 per 100 glucose)

parts.mechanism: aspartate 1-decarboxylase (beta-alanine route)
parts.source: earlier part; escape direction fwd (0.0204 per 100 glucose)

parts.mechanism: NADPH -> NADH through the serine pathway: NADP-GDH R330 (NADPH) -> phosphoserine transaminase R660 + PGDH R641 (NADH) -> R659 -> serine deaminase R511 -> pyruvate
parts.source: discovery round 1 (R511 KO 166.1, WT 0); R330, R641, R660, R659 are required by WT (capacity steps); step_costs_round1.json: WT cost 0

parts.mechanism: glutamate decarboxylase R328 -> GABA transaminase R50 -> NADP-succinate-semialdehyde DH R742 (cytosolic NADPH) -> succinate (cytosolic 2-OG oxidation bypassing matrix 2-OGDH)
parts.source: discovery round 1 (82.2 each, WT 0); R328 chosen because it is an earlier part and a WT-free step; WT cost 0

parts.mechanism: glutamate-5-semialdehyde/P5C oxidation by NAD-P5C dehydrogenase R1931 (cytosolic NADH), fed by ornithine transaminase R610 (ornithine from matrix NADPH-dependent arginine-pathway steps) and other GSA sources
parts.source: discovery round 1 (R1931 KO 77.7, WT 0); earlier part; WT cost 0

parts.mechanism: matrix branched-chain 2-oxo acid dehydrogenase R1968 (matrix NADH) -> R1971 (FAD -> ETF:Q R1977) -> ... -> HMG-CoA lyase R1974, with leucine made by WT-required synthesis steps (matrix NADPH at R76, cytosolic NADH at R45)
parts.source: discovery round 1 (18.2, WT 0); first committed, NADH-producing step; WT cost 0

parts.mechanism: matrix fatty-acid synthesis C14 -> C16 (R2230, 2 matrix NADPH) with export and peroxisomal beta-oxidation (R100, R1519 NADH, R535) = matrix NADPH -> peroxisomal NADH
parts.source: discovery round 1 (15.7, WT 0); matrix-NADPH-consuming step; WT cost 0

parts.mechanism: citrate import into the matrix through the citrate/2-oxoglutarate carrier R817 (reverse), feeding matrix NADP-IDH R1385 forward (matrix NADPH; R1385 forward is required by WT, capacity step)
parts.source: discovery round 1 (R817 KO -49.5, WT 0); WT cost 0

parts.mechanism: serine -> pyruvate + NH4 through cystathionine beta-synthase R244 + cystathionine beta-lyase R243 (homocysteine recycled), replacing serine deaminase in the serine-pathway NADPH -> NADH cycle
parts.source: discovery round 2 (143.4, WT 0); first committed step (tie at WT cost 0 with R243); step_costs_round2.json

parts.mechanism: glyoxylate exchange R1148 (no GPR): acetyl units leave as glyoxylate after ICL R490; succinate goes to SDH R740 (to Q) and cytosolic fumarase/MDH R534 (cytosolic NADH)
parts.source: discovery round 2 (135.2, WT 0); exchange chosen over transport R1149 (tie); step_costs_round2.json

parts.mechanism: malonyl-CoA + NADPH -> 3-oxopropanoate (R2121 reverse) -> acetyl-CoA + NADH (R2119), closed by ACC = NADPH -> NADH at ATP cost; R2119 also takes beta-alanine-derived 3-oxopropanoate (R2120)
parts.source: discovery round 3 (R2119 48.5, WT 0); NADH-producing step common to both feeds; step_costs_round3.json

parts.mechanism: polyamine synthesis (ODC R608, SAMDC R118, spermidine synthase R728) and oxidation (spermidine oxidase R2065) with NAD aldehyde dehydrogenases R2064 and R133 (cytosolic NADH) and NADP-SSADH R2067; MTA salvage back to methionine
parts.source: discovery round 3 (23.8, WT 0); R2065 is the single step that feeds both NADH branches (tie at WT cost 0 with R2064, R608, R118); step_costs_round3.json

parts.mechanism: cytosolic (S)-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoate oxidation R2281 -> ... -> R2284 (NADH) -> R2285 -> propanoyl-CoA + acetyl-CoA, propanoate secreted by exchange R2022 (no GPR)
parts.source: discovery round 3 (26.7, WT 0); first committed degradation step (tie with R2284, R2022); step_costs_round3.json

parts.mechanism: citrate import into the matrix through the citrate/malate carrier R831 (forward: citrate in, malate out), the same route as citrate_import_mito after R817 reverse was closed
parts.source: discovery round 3 (52.6, WT 0); step_costs_round3.json: KO/WT 0.0771 when added alone

parts.mechanism: matrix malate dehydrogenase R533 in the reductive direction (OAA + matrix NADH -> malate): matrix NADH leaves the matrix as malate and is oxidised by cytosolic MDH R534 (cytosolic NADH -> NDH2)
parts.source: discovery round 3 (R533 KO -25.2; WT requires forward); matrix-NADH-consuming step; step_costs_round3.json: KO/WT 0.0771 when added alone

parts.mechanism: pyruvate exchange R1310 (no GPR): glycolysis ends in pyruvate secretion (cytosolic NADH from GAPDH to NDH2), no PDH/TCA
parts.source: earlier part; escape direction first seen in discovery round 4 (192.1, WT 0). Discovery stopped at round 4 (KO/WT 0.0771 < 0.15), so this part is in no discovery run

parts.mechanism: cytosol <-> ER-membrane NADPH/NADP+ exchange (no GPR), the NADP side of the R1593/R1590 and R1594/R1591 transport pairs
parts.source: transport scan; escape directions first seen in discovery round 4 (FVA only; 0 in the pFBA vector). In no discovery run
